cd /workspace/submission && python3 - <<'PYEOF'
import json, sys
sys.path.insert(0,'.')
from crosscheck.common_utils import Topology, Plan, select_band
from crosscheck.dtp import RepairEngine
req = json.load(open('/workspace/examples.json'))[0]['request']
stream = req['streams'][0]
topo = Topology(stream['topology'])
settings = stream['settings']
patch = stream['events'][0]
counters = {}
for k, cell in patch['counters'].items():
    counters[k] = cell['perturbed']
demands = {(d[0], d[1]): d[2] for d in patch['demands']}
plan = Plan(stream['events'][1]['paths'], topo)
loads = [None]*len(topo.flows)
out_m={};in_m={}
for (s,d),v in demands.items():
    out_m[s]=out_m.get(s,0)+v; in_m[d]=in_m.get(d,0)+v
for f in topo.flows:
    if f.src==-1: loads[f.index]=out_m.get(f.dst,0)
    elif f.dst==-1: loads[f.index]=in_m.get(f.src,0)
for fi,tot in plan.internal_loads(demands).items(): loads[fi]=tot//1000
eng = RepairEngine(topo)
pools, base = eng.build_pools(counters, loads, True)
print('pools', pools)
print('base', base)
samples = eng.sample_values(pools)
for r,nid in enumerate(topo.router_ids):
    print('router',nid,'flows',[topo.flows[i].pair for i in topo.router_flows[r]],'signs',topo.router_signs[r],'samples',samples[r])
PYEOF
